method: Complete actual MP4 input to audiovisual model; no script supplied; model video sampling limits apply
prompt:
Inspect the entire attached English product demonstration video and listen to its actual audio from beginning to end. Audience: AI Control Layer judges. The film should show a concrete working product: real UI button click and recorded results, with a clearly disclosed omitted processing wait, plus explanatory slides. The opening illustration and diagrams are explanations, not fake UI. Assess actual audiovisual content, not the truth of software claims. No expected script is supplied.
Return JSON with coverage_seconds, viewing_method_and_limits, story_understood, speech_language, intelligibility, music_vocal_balance, narration_visual_alignment (array of timestamp range, what is heard, what is visible, match), text_readability, visual_continuity, observed_defects (timestamp, observation, severity, confidence), ending_complete, first_words_heard, last_words_heard, verdict (pass/revise), limitations.
Check that narration about starting checks, a document receipt, redaction, blocked injection, cross-tenant denial, policies, budgets, reporting and integration corresponds to the visible section. Check important titles are not cropped, labels do not cover necessary content, cuts do not remove words, and the ending is complete. Distinguish observations from taste preferences. Do not invent defects to fill a quota. Do not claim human viewing or frame-by-frame inspection: video sampling is limited. Small technical IDs need not all be legible; main outcomes must be understandable.
